primary_objective: improve recent net returns without accepting hidden timing bias or a result that exists only at low transaction costs
comparison_requirements: full label-horizon embargo for learned models

ordered_tracks.work: retest the strongest genuinely distinct provisional strategies and portfolio constructors as sleeves or conditional complements to causal GGG
extract additional economically distinct signal families from the awesome-systematic-trading inventory and test each standalone before allowing a blend
retrain the saved ML and confidence-overlay ideas on corrected causal features, with embargoed nested walk-forward evaluation and an explicit no-ML ablation
test robust sleeve allocation, turnover buffering, and calendar-aware execution only after each input sleeve passes standalone gates

promotion_rule: A challenger remains provisional unless it improves the declared recent-window objective after 50 bps, survives 100 bps and robustness gates, and has no causal audit failure.
